text: In accordance with Section 25 of the Board of Health Procedures By-law, regular meetings of the Board are determined by the Board and a schedule of those meetings shall be publicly available by the first meeting of the Board in each calendar year. On December 4, 5, and 13, 2018, City Council adopted the 2019 annual schedule of meetings for City Council and its Committees. The schedule included proposed regular meeting dates for the Board of Health. Please note that the meeting schedule is accessible on the City of Toronto's website at: www.toronto.ca/council .

The Board of Health: 1. Approved the following meeting dates for 2019: - Monday January 21 - Monday February 25 - Monday April 8 - Monday May 6 - Monday June 10 - Monday July 8 - Monday September 23 - Monday October 21 - Tuesday November 12 - Monday December 9 2. Directed that the Board of Health's remaining 2019 meetings, as noted above and outlined in the letter (January 7, 2019) from the Secretary, Board of Health, be rescheduled to start at 9:30 a.m.
